reflectionPrompts: With a strict hypergeometric 90% target in a 60-card deck, you need 16 untapped sources for Turn 1 plays from a 7-card opening hand.
For Turn 2 plays on the play, seeing 8 cards total lets you drop the 90% threshold to 15 untapped sources.
Using 14 sources for Turn 1 or 13 to 14 for Turn 2 may be a rule of thumb in some deckbuilding guides, but those counts do not hit a strict 90% probability target.
